card.name: Digit 0 or 1 ending a date
card.fires_on: The digit 0 (sometimes 1) that comes right after a 3 in a date, either the day of the month (30, 31) or the year in the 1930s. It appears in citations, news datelines and history text.

modes.label: Year in the 1930s
modes.description: The last digit of a year like 1930 or 1931 after '193'.
modes.example: by the Central Committee of the Communist Party of Germany on 24 August 193<<0>>. With these lying phrases, Communist leaders

modes.label: Day 30 of a month
modes.description: The 0 in the day number 30 before a comma and year.
